verdict.rationale: Built-in AI for banking operations is a fair question for a treasury and banking product, but the evidence pack never documents natural-language transaction search, drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The official MCP server and CLI are building blocks for outside agents, not built-in AI. Automatic risk controls are an adjacent fraud feature, not AI-generated summaries.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
